summary: The D4 float tracer (vendor/truck/truck-certified/src/kernel/tracer.rs) is landed with the packet's public API (TracePolicy + documented default, FloatStep, FloatOutcome::{Completed,ClosedLoop,Refused}, float_trace, doc(hidden) float_trace_impl + TraceStats), seed certification first through build_frame4 + an initial C2 tube, the Gauss-Newton predictor reusing the last factorization (Frame::a), grow-on-success / halve-on-failure, frame rebuilds after max_halvings with dtau reset, ClosedLoop float recurrence detection, Budget step-cap refusal, and the normative §10.2 escalation ladder decided purely from certified interval enclosures (rung 1 certified-rank rebuild -> Conditioning; rung 2 predicate parametric_degeneracy_chart_or_carrier; rung 3 TangentialCurve; rung 4 predicate isolated_contact_is_s5a; rung 5 HighOrderJet). The rank screen partitions the failed arc into RANK_SUBBOXES (16) tau sub-boxes of a NARROW perpendicular box around the branch (SCREEN_PERP, H-3), localizing rank collapse along tau. FloatStep.certified is built only from the Proven arm of c2_certify_tube4; the module never mints an ArcCert. kernel/mod.rs wires pub mod tracer; the eight required tests live in tests/kernel_tracer.rs. RESULT.json is at the worktree root.

fixture_2_parabola.outcome: Completed with no certified step: the frozen tube never certifies the quadratic branch at any width
fixture_2_parabola.note: c2_certify_tube4 returned Proven only for (near-)linear systems in every configuration exercised; a parabola 'hard part' cannot produce a halved certified step, so the dtau-grows/recovers assertions cannot be met.

measured_counts.fixture_5_isolated_node: Refused HighOrderJet (predicate rank_screen_not_isolated_not_curve), steps 0, halvings 3. The isolated node's certified rank footprint exceeds the isolated cap because the crossing component keeps g_u within the interval-hull noise over several sub-boxes.
measured_counts.fixture_6_three_nodes: Refused TangentialCurve (predicate r2_contact_zero_set_one_dimensional), steps 0, halvings 3. Three nodes clustered within one floor arc force the maximal-minor polynomial to ~1e-8 magnitude between them, below the interval-hull zero-containment resolution, so every sub-box reads rank collapse.

blocking_finding.text: Three frozen-seam behaviors block the remaining fixtures. (1) c2_certify_tube4 only certifies tubes for (near-)linear systems in every exercised configuration and demands a perpendicular half-width of ~3x the tau width even there, so the packet's curved/wrapped marching fixtures (parabola hard part, circle arcs) cannot be certified and cannot produce the asserted step streams. (2) Frame::try_new admits only unit-norm frame origins and build_frame4's Gram-Schmidt trips its 1e-12 orthogonality gate near degenerate seeds (observed dots ~1e-11 to 1e-9 as seeds approach rank-collapse points), so seeds/rebuilds must sit on S3 away from degeneracies, and a branch's single-frame certified reach (~0.3-0.35 tau) forces rebuilds at non-unit points on any longer non-S3 branch. (3) The escalation ladder's rung 3/4/5 separation needs certified rank margins the interval hulls cannot deliver at the required scale: components clustered within one floor arc force the maximal-minor polynomial to ~1e-8 between them, below hull zero-containment resolution, so isolated nodes read as broader collapses and clustered nodes read as full-arc tangencies. The ladder code, order, and refusal vocabulary are exactly as specified; none of the three stop conditions is triggered (the seam is untouched; every decision is enclosure-based; no SegmentBreak stream is emitted). Anchors A1-A5 verified unchanged.
